history: The review ran {rounds} and fixed {fixes} itself. The vet: {vet}
tracesBoard: Every statement in the spec traces to your board, your framing, your rulings, your answers, or craft recorded for your veto.
tracesNoBoard: Every statement in the spec traces to your framing, your rulings, your answers, or craft recorded for your veto.
boardSaved: The approved board is saved with the spec.
boardNotSaved: The approved board is not saved with the spec.
next: Once you've chosen Approve and said in the chat that you're done, the advisor adds the breakdown to the same PR (or, where the project keeps specs outside the repo or gitignored, beside the spec where it is kept) and vets it, and an independent read of the breakdown still runs where it applies. Then one merge word from you covers both, and the issues are filed as it merges. If another answer here changes the spec, the spec goes back through its checks, a new vet and a new approval first.
doneStep: Once every answer shows it is saved, go back to the chat and say you're done. The session then reads your answers and your verdict together.
doneStepInChat: Answer each item and the approval here in the chat, then say you're done. The session reads your answers and your verdict together.

leftoverOptions.label: Fix in a follow-up
leftoverOptions.consequence: Ships now; a follow-up issue is filed with a revisit date.

leftoverOptions.label: Fix before merge
leftoverOptions.consequence: The PR goes back for the fix and returns with a new sheet.

pr.closureQuestion: Close the spec {spec} with this merge
pr.closureIfLeft: The spec stays open after this PR merges.
pr.nothingToAccept: Nothing. The review left nothing for you.
pr.historyCap: The loop stopped at its round cap.
pr.historyNoGoAhead: No owner's word or standing ruling lets the PR go ahead without it.
pr.historyNotIndependent: {name} is from a maker's model family, so its review was not independent.
pr.historyEarlierCommit: {name} reviewed an earlier commit ({commit}), not the final one.
pr.changed: The PR moved past commit {previous} since the last sheet was made. Your answers to unchanged items are kept; the merge verdict starts over on this sheet.
pr.craftHeading: Decided as craft, for your veto
pr.verdictCaption: Saved as you tap. Your merge word is this verdict plus "done" in the chat.
pr.verdictInChat: Answer {merge} or Not yet here in the chat, then say you're done. {merge} counts only once every item above is accepted; an answer that sends the PR back is not accepted.
pr.unlocks: Unlocks when every item above is accepted: {accepted} of {total} so far.
pr.sendBack: You chose to fix something before merge, so this goes back for that fix. It returns with a new sheet; nothing to answer here.
